eps.o: A new generation of mountain men takes on the Wild North, as Randy battles wolves threatening his cattle, Kie and Dave target destructive beavers, Broc experiments with a new way to lure bears, and Connor puts his next generation of sled dogs to the test.

Broc hauls barrels of honey high into the trees in hopes of drawing bears out of hiding; Kie and Dave make use of every part of their beaver harvest; Connor takes his B-team of sled dogs into the wilderness, where one mistake threatens to derail the run; and Aron and Jen race to clear dangerous deadfall from their property without damaging their home or sparking another wildfire.
